name: Silicon Power Computer & Communications Inc.
summary: Silicon Power Computer & Communications Inc., founded in 1992 and headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, functions as a global producer and distributor of diverse memory and storage solutions. The company's extensive product portfolio includes consumer electronics such as flash memory cards, USB flash drives, portable hard drives, solid-state drives (SSDs), DRAM modules, and various external storage devices, power banks, and accessories. Beyond its standard offerings, Silicon Power also provides tailored services and a dedicated selection of industrial-grade products, including specialized SSDs, flash cards, DRAM modules, and USB drives. These advanced components are utilized across a multitude of industries, including healthcare, casino gaming, transportation, automation, cloud computing and networking, smart retail, surveillance (NVR), and embedded systems.
